passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.description: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

spells.name: Super Scorcher Breath
spells.description: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.
spells.tooltip:
Smolder belches flame, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage + {{ spell.smolderp:passive_qdamageincrease }} magic damage. If the target dies, Smolder refunds {{ manarestore }} Mana, once per cast.

Based on stacks of Dragon Practice, this Ability evolves to gain the following effects:
  • {{ stacktier1 }} Stacks: Damages all enemies surrounding the target.
  • {{ stacktier2 }} Stacks: Sends {{ tier2_numberofblowback }} explosions beyond the target that deal {{ tier2_blowbackpercentagedamage }}% of this Ability's damage.
  • {{ stacktier3 }} Stacks: Burns the target, dealing {{ tier3_burn }} max Health true damage over {{ tier3_dotlength }} seconds. Enemy champions that drop below {{ tier3_executethreshold }} total health while burning are killed instantly.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Achooo!
spells.description: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.
spells.tooltip:
Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze, dealing {{ initialdamage }} physical damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing {{ explosiondamage }} physical + {{ spell.smolderp:passive_wdamageincrease }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
spells.description: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.
spells.tooltip:
Smolder takes flight, gaining {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed and ignoring terrain for {{ duration }} seconds.

While flying, Smolder bombards the lowest Health enemy {{ totalnumberofattacks }} (rounded down) times for {{ damageperhit }} physical damage + {{ spell.smolderp:ebonusdamage }} magic damage per hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: MMOOOMMMM!
spells.description: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.
spells.tooltip:
Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage. Enemies in the center take {{ tooltiponly_totalsweetspotdamage }} physical damage instead and are Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Smolder's mom heals her son for {{ momhealcalc }} Health if she hits him.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Dragon Practice
effects:
Innate: Smolder generates a stack of Dragon Practice each time he hits an enemy champion with an ability, or whenever Super Scorcher Breath kills a minion or monster. His basic abilities deal bonus magic damage based on stacks.
 Super Scorcher Breath: Deals bonus magic damage equal to 40% : 70% (+ 0% : 16%) (based on critical strike chance) of Dragon Practice stacks.
 Achooo!: Explosions deal bonus magic damage equal to 55% of Dragon Practice stacks.
 Flap, Flap, Flap: Attacks each deal bonus magic damage equal to 12% of Dragon Practice stacks.

variants.name: Super Scorcher Breath

rows.attribute: Maximum Physical Damage with Infinity Edge

effects: Super Scorcher Breath becomes empowered with new effects based on the number of Dragon Practice stacks:
Tier 1 - 25 stacks: The fireball explodes upon collision to deal the same physical damage to nearby enemies. The explosion benefits from life steal at 50% effectiveness and applies on-hit effects.

Tier 3 - 225 stacks: Enemies hit are set on fire for 3 seconds, causing them to take bonus true damage equal to[ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD (+ 0.5% per 100 Dragon Practice stacks) of their maximum health over the duration, capped at 300 against monsters. ][ 0.83% per 100 bonus AD (+ 0.17% per 100 Dragon Practice stacks) of their maximum health each second, capped at 100 per tick against monsters. ]Subsequent applications of the burn stack, though not refreshing the duration of the previous burn. Enemy champions afflicted with the burn are also executed once Smolder deals damage to them that would leave them below 6.5% of their maximum health.
